description: Real Cercanias Madrid network (GTFS timetable) with origin-destination demand estimated from real boardings and alightings per station.
source: Renfe Cercanias GTFS (fomento_transit.zip) and Renfe 'Volumen de viajeros por franja horaria (Madrid)' 2018, CC BY 4.0, datos.gob.es
limitations: Demand between stations is estimated with a gravity model, not observed.
beta is an assumption; test other values for sensitivity.
Changing lines costs 0 minutes (no transfer penalty).
Travel time of a link is the median over both directions and all trains that day.
